title: Rivergate and Wreck
premise: Ines Halloran, a disgraced mountain guide hiding in the border town of Rivergate, is hired for a routine river survey and instead hauls up a salvage chest bearing the seal of Vellmark, a nation erased from maps forty years ago. The chest's manifest points to a passenger wreck deep in the gorge, and both a corporate salvage fleet and Ines's estranged former expedition partner arrive hunting the same prize before the seasonal permits expire. As Ines navigates the wreck's flooded passages, they uncover that their own blacklisting was engineered by the salvage company to bury a survivor's testimony sealed inside the hull. Racing the six tides, Ines chooses to expose the truth over restoring their own name, and in the end finds a found crew willing to stand with them even as the wreck is lost to the river forever.
about_author: Yara Whitlock is a former river-rafting outfitter who spent a decade guiding the gorge country before turning to fiction full-time. She writes adventure stories about people the maps forgot, from a cabin she shares with three rescue dogs and a stubborn canoe.

chapters.title: The Town That Keeps Its Head Down
chapters.summary: POV Ines. Ines takes a low-profile river survey job in Rivergate, establishing their blacklisted past and careful invisibility. Emotional beat: weary self-containment, the ache of a life shrunk to avoid notice.

chapters.title: What the River Coughs Up
chapters.summary: POV Ines. During the survey, Ines's dredge snags a sealed chest stamped with Vellmark's dead national seal. A local dockhand, Tam, helps haul it ashore. Emotional beat: startled wonder breaking through professional detachment.

chapters.title: The Manifest in the False Bottom
chapters.summary: POV Ines. Inside the chest: a manifest listing a passenger vessel lost in the gorge and a sealed testimony case. Ines recognizes the wreck's coordinates. Emotional beat: dread and temptation tangled together.

chapters.title: Six Tides
chapters.summary: POV Ines. Ines learns the concession permits expire after six tidal cycles, when the gorge floods the wreck site for the season. Emotional beat: the clock starting, old competence reawakening.

chapters.title: Ironwake Salvage
chapters.summary: POV Ines. The corporate salvage fleet arrives, led by Director Corven Ashe, who offers Ines a lucrative contract—and reveals he knows exactly why they were blacklisted. Emotional beat: the past closing in.

chapters.title: The Partner Who Didn't Drown
chapters.summary: POV Ines. Ines's estranged expedition partner, Sefa Okonkwo, appears in town, now working for Ironwake. Their bitter history surfaces in a rain-soaked confrontation. Emotional beat: betrayal, and an unhealed wound reopened.

chapters.title: Tam's Map of Nobody's River
chapters.summary: POV Ines. Tam reveals her grandmother was a Vellmark refugee and shares hand-drawn charts of the gorge's hidden channels. Emotional beat: the first fragile thread of found family.

chapters.title: Permits and Paper Knives
chapters.summary: POV Ines. Ines discovers their blacklisting paperwork was filed by a company that became Ironwake—engineered, deliberate. Emotional beat: cold fury replacing shame.

chapters.title: First Tide: Down the Gorge
chapters.summary: POV Ines. Ines, Tam, and a disgraced river pilot named Oskar slip past Ironwake's cordon into the gorge. Emotional beat: exhilaration and terror, the wilderness remembering them.

chapters.title: The Hull Beneath the Falls
chapters.summary: POV Ines. They locate the wreck wedged in an underwater ledge behind the falls, its passenger manifest matching the chest. Emotional beat: awe at the preserved dead, reverence.

chapters.title: Second Tide: The Fleet's Sonar
chapters.summary: POV Sefa. Sefa, aboard Ironwake's vessel, realizes the wreck's testimony case implicates Ironwake's founders and hesitates to report the site. Emotional beat: conscience stirring against loyalty.

chapters.title: Third Tide: The Drowned Corridor
chapters.summary: POV Ines. Ines free-dives the flooded corridor and finds the testimony case, but a cave-in traps Oskar. Emotional beat: sacrifice and the cost of the search.

chapters.title: Oskar's Lungs
chapters.summary: POV Tam. Tam and Ines rescue Oskar, who confesses he once worked for the company that destroyed Vellmark's last convoy. Emotional beat: broken men telling the truth at last.

chapters.title: Fourth Tide: Sefa Defects
chapters.summary: POV Sefa. Sefa steals Ironwake's dive plans and defects to Ines's camp, forcing an uneasy reconciliation. Emotional beat: forgiveness offered but not yet earned.

chapters.title: The Testimony of Mara Vell
chapters.summary: POV Ines. The sealed case holds a survivor's recording: proof Ironwake's founders sank the convoy to erase witnesses. Emotional beat: grief transfigured into purpose.

chapters.title: Fifth Tide: The Trap at the Narrows
chapters.summary: POV Ines. Ashe ambushes the crew at the narrows, seizing the case and stranding them as the tide rises. Emotional beat: despair, the river closing its fist.

chapters.title: What Ines Was Blacklisted For
chapters.summary: POV Sefa. Sefa reveals Ines was blacklisted for refusing to falsify a report about an earlier Ironwake disaster—the company feared their integrity. Emotional beat: Ines's shame inverted into quiet pride.

chapters.title: Sixth Tide: The Wreck Gives Everything
chapters.summary: POV Ines. With hours before the gorge floods, Ines leads a final dive through collapsing passages to retrieve the duplicate testimony hidden in the hull. Emotional beat: all-or-nothing courage.

chapters.title: The River Takes Its Due
chapters.summary: POV Ines. The wreck is claimed by the flood as they escape with the recording, the site lost forever. Emotional beat: mourning for the dead, and for the past that can't be saved.

chapters.title: Corven Ashe's Quiet Fall
chapters.summary: POV Sefa. The crew broadcasts the testimony; regulators and descendants of Vellmark descend on Rivergate, and Ironwake's permits are voided. Emotional beat: justice arriving not as triumph but as reckoning.

chapters.title: Names on a New Chart
chapters.summary: POV Ines. Ines declines reinstatement of their old certifications, choosing instead to found an independent guide service with Tam, Oskar, and Sefa. Emotional beat: choosing people over reputation.

chapters.title: The River Forgets Nothing
chapters.summary: POV Ines. One year later, the crew guides descendants of Vellmark to the falls for a memorial; the river runs high and clean. Emotional beat: peace, memory honored, home made rather than found.
